messages:
chiara: Heads up — while doing q8x4 bring-up I noticed dedupe hit-rate dropped after the tokenizer change.

mike: which tokenizer change? did tok_v2 land?

chiara: yes tok_v2 landed in runtime yesterday. promptbank_v2 shows ~3.2% more near-duplicates slipping through clustering.

ravi: could be whitespace normalization or unk handling. any quick diffs?

chiara: I ran a quick cluster sample and saw clusters with the same normalized text but different hashes. example command I used: 
```
dedupe-run --corpus promptbank_v2 --hash-algo=fnv1a --tokenizer=tok_v2 --out=dedup_v2.json
```

jen: if dedupe changes, our golden set overlap will move — that can trigger eval/regression noise. do we have numbers?

chiara: overlap on the q8x4 eval golden went 88% -> 82% (pre/post tok_v2). also some labels flagged as near-duplicates are now split.

labeler-bot: @chiara scheduled golden-refresh-v2 — 1000 items enqueued for relabel. ETA ~48h. :spiral_calendar:

mike: let's not run the full relabel until we confirm root cause. propose: manual audit of 200 high-entropy prompts + compare tokenization diffs and hash diffs.

chiara: sampling config draft: 
```
{"strata":["high_entropy","low_entropy"],"n":[150,50],"dedupe_threshold":0.85}
```

ravi: also run tokenizer comparison script: 
```
python scripts/compare_tokenizers.py promptbank_v2 --toks tok_v1 tok_v2 --metrics coverage,hash_diff
```

jen: I'll hold the labeler routing so relabel doesn't hit weekend pool. ping me when audit set is ready.

ops-bot: deploybot: rollback executed — runtime tok_v2 -> tok_v1 at 2026-03-20T10:12:34Z due to regression flagging. :wrench:

chiara: thanks ops. plan: rerun dedupe with tok_v1, diff results with the tok_v2 run, then decide whether to adjust hashing normalization or rebaseline golden.

mike: agree. please create a Jira ticket and tag eng-ml + curation. include commands and sampling config.

chiara: filed INFR-4921 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFR-4921) — added logs, sample cluster dump, and the preliminary audit checklist.

mike: cool. after the audit if we need to keep tok_v2 we should add a migration step that rewrites dedupe fingerprints and a short overlap run to compute correction factors.

chiara: noted. will follow up with the cluster diffs and a 200-item audit bundle in the ticket. :+1:
